s: Which inscription states that the Pallavas conquered Vijayapuri after defeating the Ikshvakus?
x:
The Manchikallu Inscription of Pallava Simhavarman is an important historical source that records the Pallava conquest of Vijayapuri (Nagarjunakonda) after the decline of the Ikshvaku dynasty. Following the weakening of the Ikshvakus in the 4th century CE, the Pallavas expanded northward from their original territories and occupied Vijayapuri, thereby extending their political influence into the Krishna valley. The Manchikallu inscription is one of the earliest Pallava inscriptions found in Andhra Pradesh and provides valuable information regarding the political transition from the Ikshvakus to the Pallavas. It is therefore regarded as an important epigraphic source for understanding the early expansion of the Pallava kingdom. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).
Exam Note:
• Important Inscription – Manchikallu Inscription
• Dynasty – Pallavas
• Historical Importance – Records Pallava conquest of Vijayapuri after the Ikshvakus
